description: Links one reseller tenant to one customer tenant. A reseller sees only its linked customers. Only a Platform Operator opens, changes and closes a link. A tenant is its own site; both fields hold a site name.

fields.description: Site name of the reseller tenant, for example bayi.example.test.
fields.label: Reseller Tenant

fields.description: Site name of the customer tenant, for example musteri.example.test. One customer tenant belongs to one reseller only.
fields.label: Customer Tenant

fields.description: Display name of the customer company. The reseller sees it in the customer list.
fields.label: Customer Name

fields.description: State of the customer site. Pending: the site is not ready yet. Active: the site is in use. Suspended: the site is stopped. The Platform Operator keeps it current.
fields.label: Site Status

name: Reseller Customer Link
